checks.name: standalone artifact is isolated from the source application
standalone tracing retains the verified engine and all bundled fonts
isolated production server starts on loopback
app exposes the sample download without a prefetched render
standalone server includes the actual PDF preview asset
production route returns complete private PDF bytes with a useful filename
unknown invoice IDs return a private JSON error
unsupported writes are rejected by the route
a concurrent burst receives explicit capacity errors instead of an unbounded queue
normal PDF downloads recover after a capacity burst
a real missing-glyph failure returns a generic non-PDF error
a valid document renders after an engine failure
the route enforces its page cap against a real multipage document
a valid document renders after the page limit rejects a job
a failed render child returns an HTTP error while the production server stays alive
the production server returns a valid PDF after a render-process failure
client JavaScript excludes the server PDF engine and worker

scope: Fresh public ZIP installation, production build, isolated standalone HTTP server, and exact sample-asset comparison. No application authentication or hosted-provider claim.
